dimensions.assessment: Affects small business concerns nationwide and multiple federal agencies involved in trade, security, and intellectual property.
dimensions.evidence: The Administrator of the Small Business Administration, in consultation with the appropriate Federal agency heads, shall develop and disseminate educational materials

dimensions.assessment: Involves informational outreach, educational guidance, and annual reviews rather than binding commercial restrictions.
dimensions.evidence: develop and disseminate educational materials regarding foreign adversary conduct that poses material harm to small business concerns.

dimensions.assessment: No appropriations or federal spending amounts are provided in the text.
Tasks the SBA Administrator with interagency consultation, material dissemination through district offices, and reporting to congressional committees.
dimensions.evidence: The Administrator shall make the educational materials described in subsection (a) available through district offices and other programs of the Administration.

dimensions.assessment: Establishes an ongoing, annual review and update requirement starting October 1, 2027.
dimensions.evidence: Beginning October 1, 2027, and annually thereafter, the Administrator... shall review the educational materials

missing_information: Budgetary estimates for printing and distributing educational materials.
importance_detail.rationale: Requires the Small Business Administration to develop and disseminate educational materials on foreign adversary conduct posing harm to small businesses.
